title: pass_priority(until=stack_resolved) hangs if stack clears on passive updates
description:
Bridge `passPriority()` can wait until match timeout when `until="stack_resolved"` is used and the last stack item resolves without producing a follow-up actionable callback.

In `game_20260309_162848`, Opus Brewer cast Elvish Rejuvenator, then called `pass_priority(until="stack_resolved")`. The trigger resolved completely by `2026-03-09T16:35:15-07:00` and the stack was empty, but the MCP call did not return until `2026-03-09T17:34:05-07:00`, when XMage conceded on clock.

Evidence:
- `~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260309_162848/Opus Brewer_llm.jsonl:38-39` shows `pass_priority({"until":"stack_resolved"})` started at `16:35:13` and returned only at `17:34:05` with `stop_reason":"game_over"` after `latency_ms":3532049`.
- `~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260309_162848/Opus Brewer_bridge.jsonl:225-242` shows the last actionable callback while the trigger was still active (`GAME_SELECT` at `16:35:15.461`), then only passive `GAME_UPDATE` callbacks. By `:241-242` the bridge summary is steady and there is no further `GAME_SELECT` before timeout.
- `~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260309_162848/game_events.jsonl:127-131` shows the trigger on the stack at seq 127 and an empty stack by seq 131 at `16:35:15.805`; `:134-136` shows the game only ended because Opus ran out of time at `17:34:05`.
- `~/.mage-bench/logs/game_20260309_162848/Opus Brewer_mcp.log:43-45` shows `passPriority ENTER: until=stack_resolved`; `:150-163` shows it still waiting with `pendingAction=false` until the timeout-driven `game_over` exit.
- I checked `git log --oneline --since="2026-03-09" origin/master`; the closest-looking follow-up, `5c3b87755d` (`Fix concede wakeup during golden cleanup`), only changes `Mage/src/main/java/mage/game/GameImpl.java` and does not touch bridge yield logic.

Source:
- `Mage.Client.Bridge/src/main/java/mage/client/bridge/BridgeCallbackHandler.java:3132-3134` gates the main yield logic on `pendingAction != null`.
- `Mage.Client.Bridge/src/main/java/mage/client/bridge/BridgeCallbackHandler.java:3307-3319` only checks `yieldUntilStackResolved` inside that actionable-callback branch.
- When the bridge auto-passes the last `GAME_SELECT` while the stack is still non-empty, the stack can later empty on passive `GAME_UPDATE`/`GAME_UPDATE_AND_INFORM` callbacks. `lastGameView` is updated, but the wait loop never re-checks `lastGameView.getStack().isEmpty()` once `pendingAction` is null, so the call blocks until `game_over`.

Suggested fix: while `yieldUntilStackResolved` is active, also detect stack-empty transitions from passive game updates when no pending action exists (for example by polling `lastGameView` in the outer wait loop or by waking and checking on `GAME_UPDATE`/`GAME_UPDATE_AND_INFORM`). Add a regression that resolves the final stack item without producing another actionable callback, such as an ETB trigger that auto-finishes after the last response window, and assert `pass_priority(until="stack_resolved")` returns promptly with `stop_reason":"stack_resolved"`.
